insight: Runs embedded in-process on its own Lance columnar format — there's no server to operate, unlike Pinecone or Weaviate.
name: LanceDB
tagline: Embedded multimodal vector database on the Lance format.
description: An open-source retrieval engine for AI built on the Lance columnar format. It runs in-process alongside your app — no separate server — and stores, indexes, and searches vectors, metadata, and multimodal data (text, images, video) with vector, full-text, and SQL queries. A managed enterprise lakehouse tier scales the same engine to petabytes.

modelSupport.notes: Storage/retrieval layer; bring your own embeddings.

edge: Runs in-process on the disk-efficient Lance format — no server, no port, zero-copy reads; strong on multimodal data.
pros: Embedded, in-process — no server to operate
